# NW Service Assurance Workbench

Purpose: deterministic carrier service-assurance workbench for incident triage, service paths, runbooks, and operator handoff
Free entry point: deterministic synthetic carrier-incident demo
Paid boundary: fixed-scope Incident Operations Exercise; live telemetry and production integrations require separate approval
Runtime boundary: no API key, backend, database, external dataset, model provider, or live network connection is used by the public demo
Technology: React, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Cloudflare Workers Static Assets, and versioned synthetic scenario fixtures
Canonical URL: https://nw-service-assurance-workbench.ehdjs1351.workers.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/KIM3310/nw-service-assurance-workbench
System architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/nw-service-assurance-workbench/blob/main/docs/system-architecture.md
Revenue architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/nw-service-assurance-workbench/blob/main/docs/revenue-architecture.md

Commercial route: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/?offer=nw-service-assurance-workbench#service-offers

Use this project to inspect access, transport, core, and IDC service impact; prioritized alarms; recovery ownership; change gates; and concise operator handoff notes.
